# rego

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//rego:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//rego:defs.bzl", "rego_library", "rego_test")
```

## Rules

### `rego_library`

Owns the Rego files of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Rego files of this package. |
| `data` | `label_list` | no | Data files loaded with the Rego files; not checked by dx quality. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Rego libraries this package depends on. |

### `rego_test`

```python
rego_test(name, *, srcs, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Runs opa test over Rego files and their library dependencies.
